lines.en:
Aren't you a bit early, scout?!
We saw Antares's men celebrating in the outlying villages. The rebels have begun raiding the locals!
General Antares has stooped to this? How far he has fallen since the Succession War...  Send word to the capital, maybe they can send us a real army.
I did.  Zelos... I know what you're thinking. How do you plan on explaining this to the higher ups?
lines.zh: 听到了。 泽洛斯……我知道你在想什么。你打算怎么向高层解释？

lines.en: Bah, don't worry about them. You, me, and just our troops. Once we take down this rebellion, we'll be celebrities. What say you?!
lines.zh: 行啦，别担心这些。就靠你、我，还有我们手下这点人……我们要是击败叛军，就成大红人了。你说呢？！
lines.name: 泽洛斯

lines.en: Okay Zelos, I'm with you. But I'm calling the shots this time.
lines.zh: 行吧，泽洛斯。算我一个。不过这次我来指挥。

lines.en: Fine by me. I've got your back, Protagonist.
lines.name: 泽洛斯
